bandLines: We came up for the loot. So far the floor has taken more than it has given.
Keep to the walls. Whatever nests here does not hear stone.
Lost one of ours two floors down. We are not turning back for the body.
If you find the stair before we do, leave the door open behind you.
Three of us went in. Count us on your way out and see how many there are.
The lift answers, but not always to the floor you asked it for.
We hunt what the tower feeds. Do not get between us and it.
Rest if you like. Nothing up here rests with you.
Every floor is somebody's last one. Try not to make it this one.
You climb for the top, we climb for the pay. Same stairs.

worldKindBlurb.mixed: A world that took in whoever the shaft sent it, and made a people out of the mixture.
worldKindBlurb.earthling: Earth people who climbed in and never climbed back out. They still keep Earth's calendar.
worldKindBlurb.goblin: Goblins all the way down, loud about it, and organised into something they insist is a government.
worldKindBlurb.monster: Nothing here was ever tame, and what rules it rules by being the largest thing in the room.
worldKindBlurb.beast: Animals, and the weather that moves them. Nothing here builds or believes anything.
worldKindBlurb.zombie: The plague ran its course and the population stayed on afterwards.
worldKindBlurb.fungoid: One organism wearing a great many bodies, and disagreeing with itself in all of them.
worldKindBlurb.machine: The people died and the institutions did not. The elections are still held on schedule.
worldKindBlurb.alien: Nothing on Earth applies here, and its people are unbothered by that.
worldKindBlurb.magical: Magic was never bound here, so every trade is a school and every school is a faction.
worldKindBlurb.undead: A world that kept its dead in office.
worldKindBlurb.mutant: A world that changed faster than it could agree on what it was.
worldKindBlurb.severed: Magic does not reach here. What is left is machinery, paperwork and patience.
worldKindBlurb.ruin: Whatever lived here finished, and the buildings have not been told.
worldKindBlurb.mimic: Everything is furniture until it is not.

world.heading: World
world.earthSeat: Keeps Earth's own nations and hyperpowers.
world.offworld: Offworld. No place on the world map answers for it.
